claims.text: Argos is in a small village in Uçhisar, overlooking Pigeon Valley with Erciyes Mountain beyond.

findings.quote: Located in a small village in Uçhisar overlooking the undulating Pigeon Valley and the grand Erciyes Mountain beyond

claims.text: Argos describes itself as a sustainable hotel deeply connected to the land, its history and its culture.

findings.quote: Argos is a sustainable hotel of refined details, deeply connected to the land, its history and its culture.

claims.text: Argos sits in the quiet village of Uçhisar, close enough to Göreme National Park and its attractions while keeping privacy from the tourist crowds.

findings.quote: Located in the quiet Uçhisar village, Argos is just close enough to the famous Göreme National Park and all its attractions to afford it privacy from the touristic crowds.

claims.text: Every room is different, combining traditional Cappadocia aesthetic with refined details.

findings.quote: Each room at Argos is different, but every room exudes a common design language, converging traditional Cappadocia aesthetic with refined details

claims.text: The Splendid Suite has a private pool and a contemporary interior.
The spa's indoor pool has the same cavernous feel as the cave rooms.

findings.quote: The spa’s indoor pool reflects the same comfortingly cavernous experience as our cave rooms

claims.text: The Argos Spa offers a signature massage that uses local healing herbs.

findings.quote: rest and relax with a signature massage that utilizes the power of local healing herbs to rejuvenate and calm the body

claims.text: Nahita is a Gault-Millau gourmet restaurant whose seasonal menus revive forgotten flavors and recipes of Anatolia.

findings.quote: A Gault-Millau gourmet restaurant, which has set the standard for contemporary cuisine in the region, Nahita’s seasonal menus strive to resurrect the forgotten flavors and recipes of Anatolia.

claims.text: Around 22,000 local and international wines are stored in the hotel's cave wine cellar.

findings.quote: An ever-growing collection of around 22,000 local and international wines are stored in our cave wine cellar

claims.text: The hotel can guide guests to outside activities such as a sunrise hot air balloon ride or a hike or bike ride through the valleys.

findings.quote: The iconic hot air balloon ride at sunrise, a hike or bike ride through the valleys or a skiing getaway, let us guide you through what’s on offer outside the hotel.

claims.text: Argos hosts intimate acoustic live music performances.

findings.quote: Argos is a stage for live music with intimate acoustic performances

claims.text: Event venues include ancient chapels and a Museum Hall with its own display of artifacts.

findings.quote: from ancient chapels to a Museum Hall with its own display of artifacts

claims.text: Argos is a village-within-a-village of terraces rising into the valley, with snaking paths leading to its rooms, pools, restaurants and gardens.

findings.quote: A village-within-a-village, Argos’ unique location is composed of terraces that ascend into the valley in a formation of snaking paths that lead to its rooms, pools, restaurants and gardens.

claims.text: Rooms feature stone and/or historic cave interiors, depending on availability.

findings.quote: Rooms feature stone and/or historic cave interiors depending on availability.

claims.text: The Cave Splendid Suite pairs private pool access with a historic cave interior.

findings.quote: Private pool access, historic cave interior.

claims.text: The heated outdoor pool is open all year-round and overlooks the entire valley.

findings.quote: Open all year-round, the heated outdoor pool overlooks the entire valley

claims.text: Guests can join a wine tasting in the hotel's ancient chapel.

findings.quote: From a wine tasting experience in our ancient chapel

claims.text: Some rooms are in interior sections of the hotel without windows, depending on availability.

findings.quote: Rooms may have windows or be located in hotel's interior sections without windows, depending on availability.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the cave room layout may feel unconventional for some guests.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires transportation planning.
